description: C37 Month/quarter-end seasonality: Pro MEDIUM 1/8, weekday BI plus a half-year-end close at 6 or more clusters. The last 30 days peak at 2 clusters; the current epoch (events retained 365 days) peaked at 8. The ceiling is not cut below the epoch's peak, so 8 -> 3 is held. Evidence is the demo fleet's simulated warehouse.
